2608.07147.title: DiDPO: Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization for Coding Agent Training
2608.07147.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training coding agents, where the execution feedback from compilation and tests provides objective verification. However, unlike agent tasks, coding agents face a unique and finer-grained credit assignment challenge: at each step, coding actions simultaneously pack varying changes into different regions of a code version, which makes the contribution of independent change indistinguishable. Existing RLVR methods mostly leverage the outcome reward or step-level reward, which fails to dive into a code diff and makes unique properties of coding actions invisible to training. In this paper, we propose Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization (DiDPO), a critic-free RL method that constructs fine-grained credit units directly from the structure of code diffs. DiDPO organizes multi-turn coding interactions into multiple thought--action steps and discovers code diffs across sampled trajectories. It then selects anchors by aggregating highly similar sub-diffs split from each whole diff by our ``groupability score'', which provides the splitting schema that optimally balances the semantic scope of anchors and the group mass they may form. Finally these anchors form advantage groups and project the diff-level advantage back to individual response tokens. Experiments on long-horizon coding and reasoning benchmarks show that DiDPO significantly outperforms strong agentic RL baselines. On Qwen2.5-7B-Coder, DiDPO exceeds comparable methods by over 10\% and narrows the gap with far larger models, offering a principled framework for fine-grained credit assignment in coding agent training. We also open-source verl-code, an agentic rl codebase that supports various RL methods and coding benchmarks.
2608.07147.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR）已成為訓練編碼代理的一種強大範式，其中來自編譯和測試的執行反饋提供了客觀驗證。<lb/>然而，與代理任務不同，編碼代理面臨著獨特且更細緻的信用分配挑戰：在每一步中，編碼操作同時將不同的變更打包到代碼版本的不同區域，這使得獨立變更的貢獻難以區分。<lb/>現有的RLVR方法大多利用結果獎勵或步驟級獎勵，這無法深入代碼差異，並使編碼操作的獨特性質對訓練不可見。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了差異中的差異政策優化（DiDPO），這是一種無需評估者的強化學習方法，直接從代碼差異的結構中構建細粒度的信用單位。<lb/>DiDPO將多輪編碼互動組織成多個思考-行動步驟，並在採樣的軌跡中發現代碼差異。<lb/>然後，它通過聚合從每個完整差異中拆分出的高度相似的子差異來選擇錨點，這是通過我們的“可分組性得分”提供的，該得分提供了最佳平衡錨點語義範圍和它們可能形成的群體質量的拆分方案。<lb/>最後，這些錨點形成優勢組，並將差異級別的優勢投影回個別響應標記。<lb/>在長期編碼和推理基準上的實驗顯示，DiDPO顯著超越了強大的代理強化學習基線。在Qwen2.5-7B-Coder上，DiDPO超過了可比方法超過10\%，並縮小了與更大模型的差距，為編碼代理訓練中的細粒度信用分配提供了一個原則性框架。<lb/>我們還開源了verl-code，一個支持各種強化學習方法和編碼基準的代理強化學習代碼庫。
